title: InstallationPlan test vector
description: Format of test-vectors/installation-plans/*.json (docs/installation-plan.md). `document` is the plan as received; the vector file itself satisfies the hashing restrictions, so `document` can be serialized, parsed and hashed as is. expected=valid: the plan is accepted and `derived` gives the guard inputs every implementation must compute from it. expected=invalid: the plan is rejected with the category expected_error (docs/installation-plan.md section 6). Each invalid vector contains exactly one violation.

consented_image_references.description: ImageReferences of the image_pull steps, in step order (guard input consented_image_references once this plan is consented).

required_licence_ids.description: ids of licences[] in document order: guard input required_licence_ids of the consent effect.

required_acknowledgements.description: Acknowledgements of the plan's step kinds, without duplicates, in step order: guard input required_acknowledgements.

windows_elevated_steps.description: For each privileged step of a windows plan, in step order: the step id and the elevated-helper operation. Empty for linux plans.
